g.text: Joint map quality after one same-goal choice
Two archived development states · 256 paid actions including recorded prefix and return
Markers show native-map checkpoints. Lines connect sampled times. Hollow markers show actual stops.
Panels use separate y-axis ranges. J = correctly mapped free-space fraction × whole-scene F1 at 5 cm.
